name: multiplo
description: Juego educativo para un niño de 6 años: aprender a multiplicar mediante grupos de objetos, sumas repetidas y desafíos positivos.

scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/v12-change.test.js tests/fola-assets.test.js tests/manifest.test.js tests/css-tokens.test.js tests/request-32-singular-plural.test.js tests/learning-history.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/aprende-integration.test.js tests/fola-audio-routing-e2e.test.js tests/v12-e2e.test.js tests/request-32-singular-plural-e2e.test.js tests/request-45-branding-e2e.test.js tests/request-46-option-controls-e2e.test.js tests/learning-history-e2e.test.js
scripts.metrics:db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply multiplo-metrics-local --local --config metrics/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.metrics:db:purge:local: wrangler d1 execute multiplo-metrics-local --local --config metrics/wrangler.jsonc --file metrics/maintenance/purge-expired.sql
